item.title: This Swedish 'språkcafé' is about more than just learning the language
item.description: At the Ålidhem language café in Umeå, people of all ages and cultural backgrounds come to learn Swedish – and about each other. In a political landscape where immigration is often seen as a problem, community spaces like this tell a different story.

item.title: Swedish word of the day: medlem
item.description: It's often said that the best way to make friends with a Swede is to become a member of a sports or interest group, but how do you say the word 'member' in Swedish, anyway?

item.title: Today in Sweden: A roundup of the latest news on Thursday
item.description: Social Democrats refuse to join move to stop teen deportations, PM gives speech at anniversary of Örebro school shooting, and other news from Sweden on Thursday.

item.title: Sweden charges five over hair salon triple murder
item.description: Swedish prosecutors on Wednesday charged five people over a brazen triple murder at a hair salon last year which put the spotlight on the Scandinavian country's battle with crime gangs.

item.title: Sweden's Social Democrats refuse to join opposition in stopping teen deportations
item.description: The opposition Social Democrats have refused to join the Green Party, Left Party and Centre Party in a move to reinstate an abolished law to stop so-called teen deportations.

item.title: All the odd things you can borrow from a Swedish library
item.description: When you hear the word ‘library’, you probably think of borrowing books and maybe the odd film. But what about a ukulele, a sewing machine, or even tickets to the opera?

item.title: What to bear in mind if you want to ice skate outdoors in Sweden
item.description: Four ice skaters have fallen through ice in central Stockholm since Sunday, and police are warning the public not to go out on the ice in the city centre. But where can you go skating and how do you know if it's safe?

item.title: New weather warnings issued as more snow hits Skåne
item.description: Sweden's national weather agency SMHI has issued orange and yellow weather warnings for the southernmost country of Skåne as more snow and wind hits southern Sweden.

item.title: Swedish word of the day: oväder
item.description: If there's one thing Swedes love to talk about at any time of year, it's the weather.

item.title: Today in Sweden: A roundup of the latest news on Friday
item.description: Moderates call for life sentences for gang leaders, Sweden Democrat leader drops out of reindeer race due to gun scare, orange warning in Skåne as more snow hits and more news from Sweden on Friday.
